Resorts.Name: Palisades Tahoe

SnowReport.Report:
Pick up where you lift off. While you've been enjoying the summer, the mountain has missed you and love brings us back. The temps are dropping and we've already received the first dusting across our 8-Peaks. We look to welcoming you back for another legendary winter on November 25th, weather and conditions permitting. 

With Love, 

Your Snow Reporters: Dom, Julietta, Atticus + Mountain Operations

  • For real time information at your fingertips, download the Ikon Pass App for updates on lift status, events, weather, and more.
  • Discover What's New for the 26/27 ski and snowboard season.
SnowReport.Alert: Opening Day is scheduled for November 25, 2026 weather and conditions permitting.

ParkingLots.Name: Tahoe City Park and Ride
ParkingLots.Description: Park and Ride program is on weekends only. TART Park & Ride shuttles will run frequently between Tahoe City to The Village at Palisades Tahoe, starting between 6:30 and 7:45 each morning. The return shuttles run until 5:45 p.m. The Park & Rides only drop off at The Village at Palisades Tahoe. Check the TART website for information about weekday schedules and pick up spots.
